title: Give the ache a day-and-night discipline
summary: Separation is not healed by dramatizing the ache; it is steadied by serving the Guru, remembering through the day, and speaking sweetly from sanctuary.
takeaway: Turn longing into service before it becomes display.
lifeApplication: When longing swells today, give it one embodied discipline immediately: serve, remember, or speak one sweet sentence from the Guru’s shelter.

source.shortMeaning: The ache of separation is carried toward healing by service, remembrance, surrendered speech, and the Guru’s sanctuary.
source.lifeApplication: Give longing a humble practice before it hardens into performance or complaint.

evidence.coreClaim: The ache of separation is carried toward healing by service, remembrance, surrendered speech, and the Guru’s sanctuary.
evidence.turn: The opening lines turn separation away from display and into day-and-night service, simran, surrender, and sweet speech.
